periods.time: After awakening in a Kansai hospital
periods.label: 从火海预知中醒来的总理

status.volume_role: recovered statesman and witness to changed future

personality.summary: Tsukikage is weary and self-critical after years of acting from fear of a future Tokyo inferno. He accepts that he failed to trust the younger generation enough and joins Itsuki in shouldering their generation's responsibility.
flaws: underestimated younger knights' capacity to change fate

relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Discusses the postwar settlement and agrees to reveal/end the old Rebellion-based arrangement.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Was rescued and transported back to Japan by Ouma before this volume's main rescue begins.
relationships.young-knights: Recognizes that Ikki's generation resolved crises while he slept and should not inherit the old system's debts.

periods.summary: Tsukikage awakens after repeatedly dreaming of Tokyo burned to hellish ruins, the future vision that once drove his political maneuvers. Itsuki briefs him on the Union's decision to avoid harsh escalation against the League and on Fu Xiaoli's defeat of Eilands, creating a diplomatic compromise. Tsukikage admits his mistake: he feared for Japan and acted through plans such as Akatsuki because he did not sufficiently trust the young generation. He agrees with Itsuki that the leaders who maintained Rebellion as a necessary evil must expose and end that arrangement, taking blame themselves so the next generation can inherit a cleaner world.

key_events.summary: Wakes from the Tokyo-fire vision and agrees with Itsuki to end the hidden Rebellion-era system.
